views.label: Runtime path
views.note: What happens when you open an email and press the ribbon button.

views.label: Trust boundary
views.note: The email body is read and reused entirely inside the Outlook process on your device.

views.label: Code supply chain
views.note: Every byte of pane code comes from the Worker; office.js comes from Microsoft's CDN.

boundaries.label: Your device — email body never leaves this box

cards.title: How it works
items: Outlook loads the pane from the Worker over HTTPS
Office.js hands it the open email's subject and body
parse.js detects a Teams, Zoom, Meet or Webex link
Outlook's own appointment form opens prefilled; you Save

cards.title: Security
items: No backend, no database, no secrets anywhere
Email text never crosses the network — in-process only
Manifest scope is ReadItem: the open message only
HTTPS, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, HTML-escaped output

cards.title: Risks
items: Domain or Cloudflare account takeover = code in your mailbox context
office.js is fetched from Microsoft's CDN at runtime
Outlook caches the manifest; re-add it after a URL change
